<thought>The spectrum shows a monoisotopic peak at ~199 Da (intensity 100) and a second peak at +2 Da (≈200.998 Da) with almost the same intensity (≈98 %). This 1:1 M/M+2 intensity ratio is characteristic of a single bromine atom (79Br/81Br ≈ 1:1). No other element exhibits such a distinctive pattern in this data, so bromine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['Br']</final_answer>
